# PracticeRank — Full Content Index

It gets dental practices found everywhere patients search: Google Search, Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Apple Maps, Siri, and 20+ local directories. Pricing: custom plans based on each practice's market, with no long-term contracts and no setup fees. Results: 15-25 additional new patient inquiries per month within 90 days. 90-day results-or-refund guarantee. Founded by Kody Doherty. Contact: kdoherty@practicerank.ai.

## Home

### [PracticeRank — AI-Powered Marketing for Dental Practices](https://practicerank.ai)

PracticeRank is the first dental marketing platform built for the AI search era. The way patients find dentists has fundamentally changed: 90% of patients search online before booking, 60% of clicks go to the Google Maps 3-pack, and over 40% of patients now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, or Perplexity for dentist recommendations.

Unlike Google Ads, AI search visibility cannot be purchased — practices either show up or they don't. The practices that optimize now will own these results for years. PracticeRank handles the entire process.

"Most dental practices are completely invisible in AI search results. They're spending $5,000 to $10,000 per month on agencies that only optimize for Google — while 40% of their potential patients are asking AI for recommendations and getting sent to a competitor. The window to dominate AI search in your market is closing fast." — Kody Doherty, Founder

**Key Statistics:**
- 90% of patients search online before choosing a dentist
- Over 40% of patients now use AI assistants for dentist recommendations
- 60% of clicks go to the Google Maps 3-pack — if you're not in the top 3, you're invisible
- AI search positions compound — first movers dominate for years
- 58% of dental practices have not claimed their Apple Maps listing
- Optimized directory listings generate 2.3x more calls (BrightLocal 2025)
- Professional photos on Apple Maps increase direction requests by 42% and website clicks by 35%
- Average dental patient lifetime value: $800-$2,500+
- PracticeRank clients average 15-25 additional new patient inquiries per month — a 5-10x ROI

PracticeRank Score: A 0-100 rating of your dental practice's online visibility across Google Search, Google Maps, AI search engines, review platforms, and local directories. The audit is free and benchmarks your practice against 10+ local competitors.

## What PracticeRank Does

### [How We Get You More Patients](https://practicerank.ai/#what-we-do)

**Service Pages:**
- [AI Search Optimization](https://practicerank.ai/ai-search-optimization) — detailed guide to AEO/GEO for dental practices
- [Dental SEO](https://practicerank.ai/dental-seo) — comprehensive dental SEO services
- [Google Maps Optimization](https://practicerank.ai/google-maps-optimization) — Google Business Profile and Maps 3-pack optimization

PracticeRank handles everything a dental practice needs to get found online — across every platform patients use to search. The service is fully managed: practices spend 15 minutes granting access during setup, then roughly 5 minutes per month reviewing results.

**AI Search Visibility:**
When patients ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, or Perplexity "who's the best dentist near me?" — PracticeRank clients are the ones that get recommended. We implement the proprietary signals that AI platforms rely on when deciding which practices to cite. Our clients typically go from appearing in 0 of 10 top AI queries to 7 or more within 90 days.

**Google Maps Dominance:**
60% of local dental clicks go to the Maps 3-pack. PracticeRank manages the entire Google Business Profile: weekly posts, professional photos, Q&A optimization, category management, review monitoring, and AI-drafted responses. Practices with optimized, active profiles dramatically outperform those with neglected listings.

**Review & Reputation Engine:**
Automated review generation that turns every happy patient into a 5-star review. Negative feedback gets intercepted before it reaches public platforms. AI drafts responses to all reviews within 24 hours. PracticeRank's review engine generates 2-3x more reviews compared to SMS-only systems.

**Content That Converts:**
Fresh, expert-level content published to practice websites every month. Stale websites get buried in search results — AI systems and search engines both prioritize recently updated content. PracticeRank keeps practice websites current, relevant, and ranking.

**Apple Maps & Directory Visibility:**
58% of dental practices haven't claimed their Apple Maps listing — despite Apple Maps being the default navigation on every iPhone. PracticeRank claims, optimizes, and maintains listings across Apple Maps and 20+ healthcare and local directories so patients find the practice no matter where they search.

**Referral Program:**
Automated referral triggers after every positive review, turning satisfied patients into a growth engine.

## Proven Results

### [Real Practices. Real Results.](https://practicerank.ai/#results)

PracticeRank has audited 50+ dental practices across 18 states. Here are representative results:

**Case Study — General & Cosmetic Practice, Wyoming:**
A 2-provider general and cosmetic dental practice established in 1980. Before PracticeRank: 4 new patient inquiries per month, PracticeRank Score of 42, AI visibility score of 15, 47 Google reviews at 4.6 stars, appearing in 0 of 10 top AI search queries. After 90 days with PracticeRank: 22 new patient inquiries per month (+450%), score increased to 81 (+93%), AI visibility jumped to 78 (+420%), 89 Google reviews at 4.8 stars (+89%), now recommended in 7 of 10 AI queries across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok.

"Our phone started ringing more within the first month. By month three, we were getting 20+ new patient inquiries per month that we weren't getting before. PracticeRank handled everything — we just granted access and watched the numbers climb." — Practice Owner, DDS

**Case Study — Implant & Restorative Practice, Texas:**
A 3-provider practice focused on high-value implant and restorative services. Google Maps position improved from #8 to #2, entering the 3-pack. New patient inquiries grew from 6/month to 19/month (+217%). Replaced a $8,000/month traditional SEO agency with PracticeRank at less than half the cost — with dramatically better results.

"We were spending $8,000/month on a traditional SEO agency and barely moving the needle. PracticeRank got us into the Google Maps top 3 and showing up in AI search within 60 days — for less than half the cost." — Practice Owner, DMD

**Case Study — Pediatric & Family Practice, Colorado:**
A solo provider in a suburban market. New patient inquiries grew from 3/month to 17/month (+467%). Google reviews grew from 23 at 4.3 stars to 67 at 4.9 stars (+191%). Schedule is consistently full for the first time.

"I'm a solo practitioner — I don't have time for marketing. PracticeRank took 15 minutes to set up and now I'm getting more new families than I ever did with mailers and Google Ads combined." — Practice Owner, DDS

## FAQ

### [Frequently Asked Questions](https://practicerank.ai/#faq)

**What is AI search and why should I care?**
Over 40% of patients now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and other AI assistants for dentist recommendations. When they ask "who's the best dentist near me?" — is your name coming up? Unlike Google Ads, you can't buy AI visibility. Practices that optimize now will dominate for years.

**How is PracticeRank different from my current SEO company?**
Traditional agencies only optimize for Google and charge $5,000-$10,000/month. PracticeRank gets you found across Google, Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity, Apple Maps, and 20+ directories — in one custom monthly plan with no contracts.

**How long until I see results?**
30 days to measurable improvements. 90 days to 15-25 additional patient inquiries per month. If we don't improve your score 20+ points in 90 days, you get a full refund.

**How much of my time does this require?**
15 minutes during setup. 5 minutes per month after that. We handle absolutely everything else.

**What's your guarantee?**
Full refund if we don't deliver results in 90 days. You keep everything we built. No contracts — cancel anytime. We keep clients because we deliver results, not because we trap them.

**I already run Google Ads. Do I still need this?**
Ads get you patients today, but you're renting that traffic. PracticeRank builds assets that compound: AI visibility, reviews, organic presence. The best practices run both — they multiply each other.
